item.title: Outside door 58, 24th July
item.description:
Never maintained - first reported to Camden in 2023 with no inspection or work since. Branches now reach our bedroom windows, letting insects in and stopping us opening them. The tree also drops heavy leaf and seed fall onto the public footway, which becomes dangerously slippery in wet weather, and members of my household have had serious falls on it. Pruning will not fix this as the debris returns every season. I am formally requesting removal of this tree and an inspection to that end.

item.title: Problem Summary: Damaged Vehicle Left on Public, 24th July
item.description:
A severely damaged vehicle has been left parked on the public road for approximately 3–4 months. The vehicle is a Category S write-off and has major structural damage, with one side of the car caved in and a window covered with plastic wrap. The vehicle was originally parked outside the owner’s property but has now been moved and left outside my house, where parking is very limited and only allows space for around two cars. The vehicle is currently showing as taxed and MOT’d, but an insurance check appears to show that there is no active insurance recorded. Due to the vehicle’s condition, its write-off status, the length of time it has been left, and the impact it is having on limited parking availability, I would like this vehicle investigated as a possible abandoned or nuisance vehicle. It also has no valid tax as insurance is not valid. I would appreciate it if the council could look into this matter and advise what action can be taken.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): St Fidelis Road, Northumberland Heath, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
